people.name: Maacah
people.line: Sister of Huppim and Shuppim; mother of Peresh and Sheresh

people.name: Machir
people.line: Son of Manasseh; father (ie re-founder) of Gilead

people.name: Peresh
people.line: Son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh

people.name: Rakem
people.line: Son of Sheresh, of the tribe of Manasseh

people.name: Ulam
people.line: Son of Sheresh, great-grandson of Manasseh

translations.web: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
translations.bsb: Machir’s wife Maacah gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh. His brother was named Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
translations.kjv: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
translations.asv: And Maacah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
